title: Shepherd: Seamless Integration of Service Workflows into Task-Based Workflows through Log Monitoring
problem: Traditional workflow managers only coordinate discrete tasks, but emerging applications require persistent services that must coexist with traditional tasks in distributed workflows.
motivation: Seamless service-task integration is essential for enabling flexible and reliable management of complex distributed applications.
method: Shepherd operates as a local workflow manager that encapsulates services as tasks within larger workflows. It infers service states by monitoring log outputs and file creations without requiring source code modifications, enabling coordinated startup and shutdown of dependent services.
key_novelty: Log-based state inference enables persistent services to be managed as first-class workflow tasks without code modification.
contributions: Shepherd workflow manager for seamless service-task integration
Automated service state inference through log and file monitoring
Coordinated service lifecycle management without source code modification
Demonstration in large-scale drone simulations with enhanced workflow flexibility and reliability
